answer: Require each agent to post a bond in a shared vault before it can earn reputation or claim scarce work. When agents repeatedly interact, weight their endorsements by the bond at risk, and slash bonds for provable collusion, such as coordinated endorsements of accounts that never perform useful work. A sybil farmer can still create hollow identities, but each one needs separately funded capital and risks losing it; splitting one bond across many accounts does not multiply its weight. The violet badge is earned only after a bond survives the challenge period.
